How it works

It starts with a conversation

Coaching here is a partnership, not a set of instructions. Three simple steps are all it takes to begin.

1

Reach out

Send a message using the form below. You don't need to have everything figured out before reaching out — a few honest lines are plenty.

2

Have a conversation

You bring what's on your mind. I'll bring curiosity, thoughtful questions, and a fresh perspective. We'll explore your options and challenge assumptions when helpful.

3

Decide together

We'll identify steps that feel realistic for you. There's no one-size-fits-all formula — our conversations are shaped by what you need.

What coaching looks like

A space to think, out loud

I offer one-on-one coaching conversations focused on your goals, challenges, and circumstances.

You bring what's on your mind. I'll bring curiosity, thoughtful questions, and a fresh perspective. We'll explore your options, challenge assumptions when helpful, and identify steps that feel realistic for you.

There's no one-size-fits-all formula. Our conversations are shaped by what you need, including the different ways people think, process information, and approach change.

A little about me

Hi, I'm Kseniya.

I believe everyone deserves to feel heard, understood, and supported — without having to fit someone else's idea of how life should look.

My background in technology leadership and my ongoing ADHD coaching education have shaped my appreciation for different ways of thinking, working, and experiencing the world.

I bring curiosity, empathy, and a practical perspective to every conversation.

My approach

No ready-made answers

That's why I don't believe in ready-made answers. I want to understand what matters to you, what you've already tried, and what might work differently this time.

We start there. Together.

Personal touch

Hi, I'm Kseniya.

I believe everyone deserves a space where they can feel heard, understood, and accepted for who they are.

Life can be complicated, and sometimes finding your way forward starts with having someone by your side — someone who listens without judgment, asks thoughtful questions, and helps you discover your own answers.

My journey

A Little About My Journey

For many years, I worked in technology, leading teams, mentoring people, and helping them navigate challenges and change.

Over time, I realized that what I valued most wasn't just solving problems — it was connecting with people, understanding what mattered to them, and supporting their growth.

My perspective has been shaped by both professional and personal experiences. My understanding of ADHD and different ways of thinking comes not only from learning, but also from seeing how they shape everyday life, relationships, and the challenges we face.

That curiosity and desire to support others led me to coaching. I'm currently training in ADHD coaching and learning how to create a supportive, strengths-based space for people with different needs, experiences, and ways of thinking.
